text: The zibbet skreeped.
ir: (assert (e1 skreep :tense past :subj (m1 zibbet :det the)))

text: A snerky morkel glorps the flindars.
ir: (assert (e1 glorp :tense pres :subj (m1 morkel :det a :adj snerky) :obj (m2 flindar :det the :num pl)))

text: Maria frasked the wumbert pluskly.
ir: (assert (e1 frask :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 wumbert :det the) :adv pluskly))

text: Three glarns vorsked under the trevick.
ir: (assert (e1 vorsk :tense past :subj (m1 glarn :det three :num pl) :obl-under (m2 trevick :det the)))

text: My dorbin is very blorvish.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 dorbin :poss (m2 I :pron)) :attr (blorvish :adv very)))

text: The yarbolt was a kesprin.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 yarbolt :det the) :attr (m2 kesprin :det a)))
notes: Definite, past-tense subject: an ordinary assertion about a particular yarbolt, not a generic definition (§5).

text: Tom plimped Anna a vollop.
ir: (assert (e1 plimp :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :iobj (m2 Anna :propn) :obj (m3 vollop :det a)))

text: The brindets brundered the gostrel to the hunkle.
ir: (assert (e1 brunder :tense past :subj (m1 brindet :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 gostrel :det the) :obl-to (m3 hunkle :det the)))
notes: PP attached to the verb (to-recipient/goal reading); with invented words a noun attachment is improbable but grammatically possible.

text: Some pelvards chorf near the scrandle.
ir: (assert (e1 chorf :tense pres :subj (m1 pelvard :det some :num pl) :obl-near (m2 scrandle :det the)))

text: This mibbit's norkin mezzled quickly.
ir: (assert (e1 mezzle :tense past :subj (m1 norkin :poss (m2 mibbit :det this)) :adv quickly))

text: Did the falbet snorgle the lunket?
ir: (ynq (e1 snorgle :tense past :subj (m1 falbet :det the) :obj (m2 lunket :det the)))

text: Is the drabbin glimmish?
ir: (ynq (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 drabbin :det the) :attr glimmish))

text: Who splooched the prellocks?
ir: (whq (e1 splooch :tense past :subj (m1 who :wh) :obj (m2 prellock :det the :num pl)))

text: What did Sam kravel?
ir: (whq (e1 kravel :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :obj (m2 what :wh)))

text: Where are the zoffins grindeling?
ir: (whq (e1 grindel :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 zoffin :det the :num pl) :wh-adv where))

text: Which quimbel drasked the worbet?
ir: (whq (e1 drask :tense past :subj (m1 quimbel :det which :wh) :obj (m2 worbet :det the)))

text: Why did the fennicks wemp?
ir: (whq (e1 wemp :tense past :subj (m1 fennick :det the :num pl) :wh-adv why))

text: Can you quenk the plodget?
ir: (ynq (e1 quenk :mod can :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 plodget :det the)))
notes: Indirect request not resolved: ynq with :mod can (§2).

text: Has Robin ever flurbed a snarvel?
ir: (ynq (e1 flurb :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :obj (m2 snarvel :det a) :adv ever))

text: How did the pobbet zorp so vorpily?
ir: (whq (e1 zorp :tense past :subj (m1 pobbet :det the) :adv (vorpily :adv so) :wh-adv how))

text: Skreep the zibbets.
ir: (command (e1 skreep :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 zibbet :det the :num pl)))

text: Don't glorp the vorpy morkel!
ir: (command (e1 glorp :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 morkel :det the :adj vorpy)))

text: Plimp me the trelly vollop.
ir: (command (e1 plimp :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :iobj (m2 I :pron) :obj (m3 vollop :det the :adj trelly)))

text: Vorsk quietly beside the trevick.
ir: (command (e1 vorsk :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obl-beside (m2 trevick :det the) :adv quietly))

text: Never mezzle a dranky norkin.
ir: (command (e1 mezzle :pol neg :negword never :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 norkin :det a :adj dranky)))

text: Give the snarvel to the gostrel.
ir: (command (e1 give :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 snarvel :det the) :obl-to (m3 gostrel :det the)))

text: Chorf the scrandle before it brunders.
ir: (command (e1 chorf :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 scrandle :det the) :before (e2 brunder :tense pres :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m2))))
notes: it: the implicit you is excluded (deictic, implicit); scrandle is an invented noun, compatible with it (§6).

text: Don't wemp the drabbins yet.
ir: (command (e1 wemp :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 drabbin :det the :num pl) :adv yet))

text: The blorvish glarn didn't skreep the dorbins yesterday.
ir: (assert (e1 skreep :tense past :pol neg :subj (m1 glarn :det the :adj blorvish) :obj (m2 dorbin :det the :num pl) :adv yesterday))

text: The kesprins will not drask the yarbolt.
ir: (assert (e1 drask :tense fut :pol neg :subj (m1 kesprin :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 yarbolt :det the)))

text: Anna has never quenked a brindet.
ir: (assert (e1 quenk :tense pres :aspect perf :pol neg :negword never :subj (m1 Anna :propn) :obj (m2 brindet :det a)))

text: The pelvards were flurbing the mibbits.
ir: (assert (e1 flurb :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m1 pelvard :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 mibbit :det the :num pl)))

text: The falbet had been zorping frondishly.
ir: (assert (e1 zorp :tense past :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 falbet :det the) :adv frondishly))

text: We will be glorping the norkins tomorrow.
ir: (assert (e1 glorp :tense fut :aspect prog :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 norkin :det the :num pl) :adv tomorrow))

text: The lunket isn't murvish.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :pol neg :subj (m1 lunket :det the) :attr murvish))

text: No zoffin has splooched the quimbel.
ir: (assert (e1 splooch :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 zoffin :det no) :obj (m2 quimbel :det the)))
notes: Negation by the determiner 'no'; the clause itself is not :pol neg (spec lists not, n't, never as clause negators).

text: The worbets might kravel tomorrow.
ir: (assert (e1 kravel :mod might :subj (m1 worbet :det the :num pl) :adv tomorrow))

text: Sam is going to frask the plodget.
ir: (assert (e1 frask :tense fut :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :obj (m2 plodget :det the)))

text: The fennick should not have vorsked.
ir: (assert (e1 vorsk :mod should :aspect perf :pol neg :subj (m1 fennick :det the)))

text: The snarvels are being plimped by Tom.
ir: (assert (e1 plimp :tense pres :aspect prog :voice pass :subj (m1 snarvel :det the :num pl) :obl-by (m2 Tom :propn)))

text: The gostrel was mezzled by a hunkle.
ir: (assert (e1 mezzle :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 gostrel :det the) :obl-by (m2 hunkle :det a)))

text: The zibbet that skreeped the morkel is snerky.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 zibbet :det the :rel (e2 skreep :tense past :subj m1 :obj (m2 morkel :det the))) :attr snerky))

text: I saw the flindar which Tom glorped.
ir: (assert (e1 see :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 flindar :det the :rel (e2 glorp :tense past :subj (m3 Tom :propn) :obj m2))))

text: The wumbert who frasked me a vollop left.
ir: (assert (e1 leave :tense past :subj (m1 wumbert :det the :rel (e2 frask :tense past :subj m1 :iobj (m2 I :pron) :obj (m3 vollop :det a)))))

text: The glarns that the dorbin vorsked were dranky.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 glarn :det the :num pl :rel (e2 vorsk :tense past :subj (m2 dorbin :det the) :obj m1)) :attr dranky))

text: Anna found a trevick that no kesprin had brundered.
ir: (assert (e1 find :tense past :subj (m1 Anna :propn) :obj (m2 trevick :det a :rel (e2 brunder :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 kesprin :det no) :obj m2))))

text: Every pelvard that chorfs loudly will snorgle.
ir: (assert (e1 snorgle :tense fut :subj (m1 pelvard :det every :rel (e2 chorf :tense pres :subj m1 :adv loudly))))

text: The mibbits we splooched were glimmish.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 mibbit :det the :num pl :rel (e2 splooch :tense past :subj (m2 we :pron) :obj m1)) :attr glimmish))

text: Did you see the norkin that drasked the zoffin?
ir: (ynq (e1 see :tense past :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 norkin :det the :rel (e2 drask :tense past :subj m2 :obj (m3 zoffin :det the)))))

text: The falbet I wemped yesterday is murvish.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 falbet :det the :rel (e2 wemp :tense past :subj (m2 I :pron) :obj m1 :adv yesterday)) :attr murvish))
notes: yesterday attached inside the relative clause (the only reading compatible with present-tense 'is').

text: If the lunket quenks, the drabbins will flurb.
ir: (assert (e1 flurb :tense fut :subj (m1 drabbin :det the :num pl) :condition (e2 quenk :tense pres :subj (m2 lunket :det the))))

text: Unless you zorp the prellock, it will vorsk.
ir: (assert (e1 vorsk :tense fut :subj (m1 it :pron :ref m3) :unless (e2 zorp :tense pres :subj (m2 you :pron) :obj (m3 prellock :det the))))
notes: it: you is deictic (excluded); prellock is an invented noun in the unless-clause, outside the pronoun's own clause.

text: The quimbel skreeped because the worbet glorped it.
ir: (assert (e1 skreep :tense past :subj (m1 quimbel :det the) :cause (e2 glorp :tense past :subj (m2 worbet :det the) :obj (m3 it :pron :ref m1))))
notes: it: worbet excluded by binding (subject of the pronoun's own clause); only quimbel.

text: Although the fennick was trelly, the plodget frasked it.
ir: (assert (e1 frask :tense past :subj (m1 plodget :det the) :obj (m2 it :pron :ref m3) :concession (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 fennick :det the) :attr trelly)))
notes: it: plodget excluded by binding (subject of the pronoun's own clause); only fennick.

text: When the snarvel kraveled, the pobbets mezzled blorvishly.
ir: (assert (e1 mezzle :tense past :subj (m1 pobbet :det the :num pl) :adv blorvishly :when (e2 kravel :tense past :subj (m2 snarvel :det the))))

text: The gostrel chorfed after the hunkle had plimped.
ir: (assert (e1 chorf :tense past :subj (m1 gostrel :det the) :after (e2 plimp :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m2 hunkle :det the))))

text: If Sam had splooched the zibbet, the morkel would have skreeped.
ir: (assert (e1 skreep :mod would :aspect perf :subj (m1 morkel :det the) :condition (e2 splooch :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m2 Sam :propn) :obj (m3 zibbet :det the))))

text: The dorbins drasked the yarbolt so that the kesprin could wemp.
ir: (assert (e1 drask :tense past :subj (m1 dorbin :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 yarbolt :det the) :purpose (e2 wemp :mod could :subj (m3 kesprin :det the))))

text: The brindets snorgled while the pelvards were zorping.
ir: (assert (e1 snorgle :tense past :subj (m1 brindet :det the :num pl) :while (e2 zorp :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m2 pelvard :det the :num pl))))

text: Tom said that the mibbit would quenk the flindar.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :comp (e2 quenk :mod would :subj (m2 mibbit :det the) :obj (m3 flindar :det the))))
